mode: PAPER ONLY. scripts/simulate.py places no orders and uses no account. It records what a fixed rule would have done at the observed prices.
note: Strategy definitions for scripts/simulate.py. Each signal is one swing in data/live/alerts_archive.json (built by scripts/build_alerts.py). Edit this file to change a rule; no code change is needed. Rules are project choices unless marked otherwise.
entry_rule: Taker entry at the observed ask in the observation at the alert's to_time: YES at yes_ask_dollars; NO at 1 - yes_bid_dollars (documented reciprocal relation, https://docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/orderbook_responses). No quote at that time, or an entry outside 0.01-0.99, means not filled.
exit_rule: Hold to settlement. A position settles only when the market appears in the settled list with result yes or no (https://docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/market_settlement). Before that it is marked to the current bid: unrealised = bid - entry - entry fee - exit fee at that bid.
one_open_position_rule: At most one open position per strategy per market. Further signals for the same market are counted as skipped_duplicate.
min_settled_origin: Project choice. Below this many settled positions a strategy is reported as insufficient sample, not as profitable or unprofitable.

fee_model.formula: fee = round up to the next cent of ( M x 0.07 x C x P x (1 - P) ), with P = price in dollars, C = contracts, M = taker multiplier
fee_model.source: https://kalshi.com/docs/kalshi-fee-schedule.pdf (General Trading Fees; Non-Standard Fees table; July 7, 2026 update)
fee_model.default_origin: General formula states M defaults to 1 unless otherwise indicated.
fee_model.settlement_fee: none (fee schedule: 'There is no settlement fee.')
fee_model.multiplier_caveat: Per-series multipliers M (fee_model.multipliers) were read from the text of the non-standard fee table in https://kalshi.com/docs/kalshi-fee-schedule.pdf (July 7, 2026). The PDF text extracts with noise, so the values need a visual check by a person (Flagged F-20). Series not in the table use default_taker_multiplier (1).

strategies.name: Momentum: follow every swing
strategies.description: After an up-swing buy YES; after a down-swing buy NO. Tests whether a move that has just happened keeps going.

strategies.name: Fade: bet against every swing
strategies.description: After an up-swing buy NO; after a down-swing buy YES. Tests whether a move that has just happened reverses.

strategies.name: Momentum on experimental high-ROI screen only
strategies.description: S1 restricted to swings that pass the experimental high_roi screen (not an owner-approved ROI model).

strategies.name: Fade on experimental high-ROI screen only
strategies.description: S2 restricted to swings that pass the experimental high_roi screen (not an owner-approved ROI model).

signal_source: data/live/alerts_archive.json: every consecutive last-price pair with |change| >= $0.10 (threshold from the brief; data/alert_rules.json).
high_roi_definition: The 'high_roi' flag in the archive is the dashboard's EXPERIMENTAL 'Model watch' screen (fee-schedule seed series with positive volume_24h_fp). It is not an owner-approved ROI model (Flagged F-14).
